title: Off-grid house for the Darlington Point block
must: liveable year-round in Riverina heat and frost
runs off-grid: power, water and wastewater on site
prefer: shed home or similar low-cost build
cheapest total cost to move in, not cheapest kit
notes: Cheapest decent option wins. Always compare the landed, move-in cost: house, freight, slab, labour, fit-out, approvals, plus the off-grid and site works every option needs.
